text: Comet Treks Comet Treks. The UCC Comet Treks is a unique program designed to enhance the educational and professional development of students by facilitating employer site visits. Comet Treks offer students the chance to explore potential career paths, network with professionals, and gain a broader understanding of various industries. A typical Comet Trek includes: A tour of the company Presentation or information session Panel discussion

Networking opportunities with UTD alumni and industry professionals Comet Treks are posted on 12twenty. COMET TREKS SCHEDULE For Employers. If you are an employer interested in hosting a Comet Trek, please contact us at experientiallearning@utdallas.edu. CONNECT WITH US. Hasan Iqbal – Emerson Mechanical Engineering. “I had the opportunity to attend Comet Trek in the Fall of 2024 and visit Emerson in McKinney. As a Mechanical Engineering student in ECS undergrad, Emerson was one of the companies I wanted to apply for an internship/Co-Op. “During the visit, I was able to introduce myself and connect with engineers working at Emerson directly, and ask a ton of questions about the company and roles offered.
After applying for a Co-Op role, I was able to easily interview with the company because they already knew me from the visit, which resulted in getting hired for a Co-Op the following year!”

“Attending the Comet Trek to the CBRE Richardson office was truly a transformative experience for me. Before the trek, I had very limited knowledge about what CBRE does and the commercial real estate industry as a whole. But this visit gave me valuable insight into the company’s operations, culture, and the broader industry landscape. “During the session, we were introduced to the Digital & Technology Summer Internship program and were given a clear overview of the program structure and timeline. That experience sparked my interest and gave me the confidence to apply. “I’m excited to share that I was shortlisted and later offered a position for the summer internship—and I truly believe that Comet Trek played a huge role in securing this opportunity.

During my interview, I was able to speak about my experience during the trek, and it clearly demonstrated my interest and passion for both CBRE and the commercial real estate industry.” Kunuth Siddiqui – Trinity River Authority

“Attending multiple Comet Treks, including visits to Trinity River Authority, Motorola Solutions, and other. organizations, has been an incredibly valuable experience for me. Each trek gave me insight into the company’s mission, culture, and the wide range of career paths available, while also allowing me to connect directly with professionals and learn from their experiences. “After attending the Trinity River Authority trek, I was fortunate to be hired as an intern there, which made the experience even more meaningful. That internship not only strengthened my technical and professional skills but also played a key role in preparing me for my later internship with Toyota. “I am truly grateful to the University Career Center for organizing these opportunities, as they provide students with firsthand exposure that can genuinely shape their career paths and open doors to future success.”

“I had a fantastic opportunity to attend the Comet Trek at Emerson—a global leader in engineering solutions. It was fascinating to hear Don Haugh share their progress and how they leverage technology, including Power BI for data analysis to drive informed decision-making across their worldwide operations.” Masters Student – JSOM.
